t: This is a statue of Queen Victoria at Blackfriars Bridge. It was made by the sculptor Charles Bell Birch, who lived from 1832 to 1893. Victoria was Queen from 1837 until her death in 1901. Her reign of sixty-three years and 216 days was longer than any before it, and it gave its name to the Victorian era, a time of industrial, political, scientific and military change. In 1876 parliament also voted her the title of Empress of India.
